locations.note: The story follows the aspiring photojournalist Reza Shirazi through Tehran during the 1978 Iranian Revolution, framed by a 1980 interrogation.
Reza's story builds toward Black Friday, the September 1978 protest in Jaleh Square where troops opened fire on the crowd.
In 1980 Reza is taken to Evin, where the warden Asadollah Lajevardi interrogates him, and the story returns to Evin in flashforwards.

routes.name: Reza Shirazi
routes.note: From the Evin interrogation back to the 1978 streets and the Black Friday protest.
